caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden ladle with a wide, shallow bowl and a smoothly curved handle that arches upward and to the right. The handle has a decorative cut-out design near the end, forming a loop and a small curved hook. The ladle is rendered in shades of brown, showing the natural grain and texture of the wood. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or patterns. In the bottom right corner, the name "ELMER WEISE" is written in capital letters.
title: Wooden Dipper
